cause: Closure validation treated the current work item as the complete authority source and parsed accepted-watch input through convenience text APIs, so byte-boundary failures and claim-only escalation signals could disappear or fail open.
prevention: Read accepted-watch input as bounded strict UTF-8 physical lines; resolve one exact active claim context from the primary checkout; merge only approved authority fields; validate explicitly linked released claims before mutation; and require a current-work canonical Compound for every terminal resolution carrying repeated-failure authority.
summary: Repeated-failure closure could be bypassed when accepted-watch bytes were normalized, malformed, or unbounded, and when active or explicitly linked released claim authority was omitted during closeout.
title: Fail closed across accepted-watch and claim authority boundaries
